# Thunderbird history batch 002: code and review lessons

Source: `Thunderbird comm checkout`, `origin/main` at `6ccc9d3f07d89f3d05984c119f20788417cecceb`, inspected 2026-10-06. Continue after batch 001 from `24cde67836eaee8557c2e8dd0226f828acae70bd^`. This batch contains the next 500 first-parent, non-merge, human-authored commits, from `4a7a67b0047a876cc0743e6fa86227faa7dbb456` (2026-09-27) through `fa682aa39bf108bb41c2b595461f9b66021c3583` (2026-08-20). Skip 114 intervening automation commits (locale bumps, vendored syncs, build triggers, version/config churn). Next batch starts at `fa682aa39bf108bb41c2b595461f9b66021c3583^`. All 500 landed diffs were indexed and scanned for repeated added-code patterns; representative implementations and tests were read in depth. Of 500 commits, 482 link to 478 unique Phabricator reviews; 18 have no review link. A hidden browser read 468 full review timelines, including older changes; 10 were access-restricted. The visible timelines contain 1,990 nonempty comments, including 212 reviewbot comments. Do not infer from restricted reviews. The batch includes many Firefox/Enterprise ports, so imported patterns do not automatically become Thunderbird-wide rules.

## Repeated landed-code patterns

- 263 of 500 commits touch tests. Added code in 96 commits has named `add_task(async function test...)`; 129 add `Assert` calls; 54 add `registerCleanupFunction`; 55 add explicit state/event waits. Treat these as common test practices, not syntax mandates. Write assertions about observable behavior, with messages that say what should happen. In D317045, a reviewer asked for the “should” form; the landed test uses it. https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D317045 and https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/42c912a7b24ac3b0219750a8d381540a712ba7be
- 14 commits for bug 2066871 move browser tests from manual `Services.prefs.set*`/`clearUserPref` to awaited `SpecialPowers.pushPrefEnv`; D310774 explicitly requested this in a new test. Use `popPrefEnv` when a test must restore a pref before its own end. https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D310774 and https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/17bcac61ab588a46b167f1e345c64a5ef9f640b2
- 116 commits add `/**` documentation blocks; some are JSDoc, some are other languages. CSS changes favor logical sizing/spacing properties in the examined UI patches; D327335 requested `min-inline-size`. The sample still uses many `px` values, so there is no evidence for a blanket `rem` rule. The JavaScript diffs also do not support a global `===` rule; follow the local code and lint rules. https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D327335

## How the code works and why fixes were needed

- Graph Calendar delta refresh queues local event changes in order, reuses a pending operation, and advances `syncStateToken` only after the changes succeed. The next patch implements `calIChangeLog`, stores the token in offline storage metadata, and uses that storage as the backing calendar when present. A failed/partial sync must not advance the token or lose changes on retry. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/2e63bfdb356a735c782ca35d4523349c64f5847c and https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/f4eddc3aee8d
- Calendar password prompts serve concurrent requests. The old 60-second record was shared by a provider, so one request's `PREVIOUS_FAILED` could remove a replacement login supplied to another. The fix records `{key, password}` by request `loadInfo` in a `WeakMap`, because an auth retry may use a new channel but keeps that load info. It removes only the same password that this request received and the server rejected. Tests cover two requests and a saved replacement. https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D319397 and https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/2fdf9b286f5e4ff85e373defa4413f0e50b83340
- IMAP move playback must set `nsMsgFolderFlags::OfflineEvents` from the operations still in the folder database before closing that database. Clearing the flag merely because one playback list was exhausted could leave newly queued moves unplayed and lose messages. The landed regression tests check what reached the server, in both message stores. https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D318396 and https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/9bdc099e6cefe74155e2d7c9043c8c691721d07a
- A cached Calendar reset must await `calICalendarProvider.deleteCalendar()` before it reuses storage. The later fix also clears item and recurrence caches after deletion, keeps offline flag caches that have no refill path, and checks whether the calendar was unregistered during the await. The provider API now returns a promise for completed deletion. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/368ff70f6e02355be7948e50d985be71f3c62509 and https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/186e2142b778af3fcbfe09f911bc7a8b26da72c1
- Account Hub handles Enter once in its controller and calls `form.requestSubmit()` for custom controls so normal validation and submit handlers run. It guards IME composition, repeated keys, and disabled forward controls because native form validity does not cover every Account Hub control. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/43e58543de8a6d3a96e4f4ae4a70ae83b04cce6b
- Enterprise policy ports compare Thunderbird policies with Firefox in a browser test. The test tracks exact accepted differences and missing policies, reports new differences, and fails when an allowed difference becomes stale. This is an intentional parity check with local exceptions, not blind copying of Firefox code. https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D317897 and https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/e29d0dc36e4bff897870c483b31b2a556487ebe0

## Review-backed lessons

- Put protocol-specific details in their provider and expose a generic contract to shared Calendar code. D309500 moved CalDAV response and href handling into the CalDAV provider; invitation recovery uses `calIErrors.UID_CONFLICT` and `calICalendar`. Its reviewer also requested separate named tasks for readable test logs and removal of bug numbers from source comments. https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D309500 and https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/7273f0678012e35db6be13886cd990e63cfe0cd6
- Test the user-visible result, not an incidental mechanism. In D318396, IMAP move tests were rewritten to check the messages received by the server instead of inspecting offline-operation internals. The fixed delay and extra timeout factor then disappeared. https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D318396 and https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/9bdc099e6cefe74155e2d7c9043c8c691721d07a
- Preserve useful failures. D325606 changed a numeric completion status to rejection so callers retain a stack, added a folder-creation failure test, and used the component send logger. D322584 asked for an accurate error code and a comment that `nsMimeNewURI()` can return null on parse failure. These are local contracts, not a ban on status results. https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D325606 and https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D322584
- Update comments when they describe behavior a test no longer exercises (D324599). Explain a surprising contract or reason (D322584, D323560); remove redundant explanations or bug-history notes when code and commit history already supply them (D323922, D309500). Document real parameters and returns where the file's JSDoc/lint requires them (D316772). https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D324599 and https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D323922
- Review keyboard focus and assistive-technology announcements as behavior. D321072 requested focus move and restoration when a reminder form opens/closes; D319656 raised missing live error status for a photo picker; D320277 clarified that XUL toolbarbuttons need explicit tab stops. Test these paths, not only ARIA attributes. https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D321072 and https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D319656
- A patch's test must actually run and assert the intended condition. D326810 caught a misplaced Enterprise test and a failing selector; D319976 caught a zero-length list satisfying a wait and a leaked tab that broke `--verify`. Start event waits before the action and await async work (D327335, D327336). https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D326810 and https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D319976
- Commit titles should describe the change, not just the bug symptom. D320126 asked for the what and why; D321455 changed an intermittent-test title to name the stale selection update. Ported changes should identify the upstream bug (D327554). https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D320126 and https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D321455

## Use in future work

Before coding or review, check the nearby component, its tests, and the current lint rules. Treat each review remark as a hypothesis until the final patch confirms it. D324767 accepted direct `.disabled` properties but kept `hasAttribute("checked")` for a XUL menuitem where `.checked` did not work. D319976 contains disagreement about rendering and performance; do not turn the disputed proposals into project rules. The work snapshot shows active Calendar dialog/Graph calendar, Enterprise, and mailnews changes, not a published roadmap.
